# What do I set my own text in?

Read this when your own markup sets a face, a weight, a size, a line height or a tracking.

A role names the face, the weight or the line height for one kind of text, and the scale holds the steps behind it. The steps are on [the type scale page](../scales/type-scale.md).

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

| role | what it is |
| --- | --- |
| `--ff-eyebrow` | Which face an eyebrow takes: the small line above a title that says what kind of thing this is |
| `--ff-heading` | Which of the three faces a heading takes |
| `--ff-label` | Which face the LABEL register takes: a field's label, a column header, a section label, a group header, a badge, a keyboard cap |
| `--fw-control` | The weight of the text on a control the user presses: a button's label, a tab, a menu item, a chip |
| `--fw-eyebrow` | The weight of an eyebrow |
| `--fw-heading` | The weight of a heading set in the display face: a card's title, a dialog's title, a page head, a stat card's value |
| `--lh-heading` | The leading of a heading in the display face, standing opposite lh-prose: one plugin wants a title packed and its paragraphs open, another wants both even, and the contrast between the two IS the hierarchy on a screen where nothing is drawn |
| `--lh-prose` | The leading of text somebody reads: a dialog's body, an empty state's message, a page head's subtitle, a hint under a field |
| `--measure-prose` | How wide a column of prose is allowed to get, in ch, which is the only unit that means anything here: a measure that does not track the font size is not a measure at all |
| `--step-eyebrow` | Which step on the ladder an eyebrow takes |
| `--step-label` | Which step on the ladder a label takes: a column header, a card's row label, a chart tile's name, the head of a menu group |
| `--step-title-hero` | Which step the one line a landing page is built around takes |
| `--step-title-page` | Which step the title of a PAGE takes: the one heading that names the screen a reader is on |
| `--step-title-section` | Which step the title of a SECTION takes: the head of a region on a page, above the surfaces inside it |
| `--step-title-surface` | Which step the title of a SURFACE takes: a card, a panel, a tile |
| `--track-eyebrow` | The tracking of an eyebrow |
| `--track-heading` | The tracking of a heading in the display face |
| `--track-label` | The tracking of a label, born at the step the field-label slots already name |
| `--tt-eyebrow` | Whether an eyebrow is set in capitals |
| `--tt-label` | Whether the label register is set in capitals |

<!-- @tree end -->
